description: This file defines serialization utilities, including functions for converting between strings and various data types, handling character encoding conversions, and serialization of binary data (hex and Base64). It also declares a template parser class for processing serialized text streams. The file is part of the Thunder::Core namespace and includes external dependencies and internal utility functions related to serialization and character encoding.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing serialized text streams, managing states such as loaded, quoted, and whitespace handling, and invoking parent handlers during serialization.

methods.name: ToCharacter
methods.description: Converts a character string to a TCHAR character array, handling Unicode and platform-specific conversions.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts various string types and character arrays to std::string or std::wstring, depending on Unicode settings.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses strings to convert them into numeric types or booleans, supporting different formats.

methods.name: ToHexString
methods.description: Serializes binary data into a hexadecimal string representation, optionally with delimiters.

methods.name: FromHexString
methods.description: Deserializes a hexadecimal string back into binary data.

methods.name: ToString (for binary and Base64)
methods.description: Serializes binary data into Base64 string representation, with optional padding.

methods.name: FromString (for binary and Base64)
methods.description: Deserializes Base64 strings into binary data.

methods.name: CodePointToUTF16
methods.description: Converts a Unicode code point to UTF-16 low and high surrogate parts.

methods.name: UTF16ToCodePoint
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 surrogate pairs back into a Unicode code point.

methods.name: ToCodePoint
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 or UTF-16 encoded character sequence into a Unicode code point.

methods.name: FromCodePoint
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode code point into a UTF-8 or UTF-16 character sequence.

methods.name: ToQuotedString
methods.description: Returns a quoted version of a string with a specified quote character.
